description: Virga viridis lucet. Nemo scit quare. Simulamus scire.
summary: Heliopause is a space mission design game where the key mechanic are the tradeoffs. Every travel costs fuel and fixing / upgrading your spaceship costs you resources. Your goal is to scape the solar system you're in and after that keep exploring the universe on endless mode.
details:
It's a game made on web tech, with phaser as the engine, react and typescript.
It focuses on people getting interested on spaceships and introduces the concepts and difficulties of planning a space mission incrementaly so they are not overwhealmed.
It lives on a scifi universe to help loosen up some strict reality rules so this problems can rise slowly at a learners pace and still be fun to play.
